verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Postman's API client supports HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests (postman-docs-31, postman-docs-50), but WebSocket and SSE support are never explicitly mentioned in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of WebSocket request support, explicit documentation of SSE (Server-Sent Events) request support, and independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-protocol usage.
